_note: MACHINE-READABLE INDEX of policy/GENERATION_LAW.md. It POINTS AT owners; it never restates rule text - the rule in policy/registry.json is the single source of truth for every requirement. Verified by policy/law_gate.py, which run_catalog.py runs before anything else.
origin: user instruction: permanent hardcoding of design supremacy, source-before-generation, per-angle source warning, no AI redraw, catalog consistency, diamond purity, and one-rule-per-topic
enforced_first_by: run_catalog.py -> policy/law_gate.py check() before every catalog

clauses.title: No AI redraw of the jewellery - ever
Source reading is compulsory before generation
Per-angle source coverage - warn, then skip or continue
One catalog, one piece - consistent throughout
Diamonds: crystal clear, natural, pure - every image
The law is the boundary - one rule per topic

supremacy.on_conflict: the law wins; an engine or mode that cannot satisfy a clause is refused, never the clause relaxed

change_procedure: Edit the OWNER RULE in policy/registry.json via a supersession that carries the old rule's failure_cases and statement, then: python policy/law_gate.py --restamp && python policy/law_gate.py --check
